description:
Lawgical gives ChatGPT the actual text of Vietnamese law. Search more than 150,000 legal documents: Luật, Nghị định, Thông tư, Nghị quyết and provincial regulations — sourced from official government publications; read a document's outline (Chương / Mục / Điều); pull the full text of a specific instrument by its reference number (số ký hiệu) or title; and browse which Luật are currently in force.

Answers are grounded in the stored statutory text, so ChatGPT can quote the exact Điều and Khoản and cite the document it came from instead of paraphrasing from memory. Ask in Vietnamese or English; legal terms stay in Vietnamese.

Built for founders checking a compliance question, in-house teams researching a regulation, and individuals verifying their rights.

Lawgical is a research tool, not legal advice. Always confirm a cited provision against the official text before acting on it. It covers Vietnamese law only and holds no foreign statutes.

defaultPrompt: Điều 4 Luật Bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân quy định những quyền gì cho chủ thể dữ liệu?
What does Vietnamese law say about probationary period limits for employees?
Nghị định nào hướng dẫn thi hành Luật Bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân 2025?

name: lawgical

positive.description: Read one article of a law by its number (get_document).
positive.prompt: Use Lawgical to look up what Article 4 of Vietnam's Personal Data Protection Law 91/2025/QH15 says.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Điều 4 "Quyền và nghĩa vụ của chủ thể dữ liệu cá nhân" of Luật Bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân 91/2025/QH15 (Quốc hội, in force since 01/01/2026): the rights in Khoản 1 (to be informed; to consent, refuse or withdraw consent; to view and correct; to request provision, deletion or restriction and to object; to complain, sue and claim compensation; to ask for protection measures) and the obligations in Khoản 2, citing the law by number.

positive.description: Find the documents that govern a topic, Vietnamese prompt (search_legal_docs).
positive.prompt: Dùng Lawgical tìm văn bản pháp luật về bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân.
positive.expected_behavior: Names Luật Bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân 91/2025/QH15 (Quốc hội) as the governing law and Nghị định 356/2025/NĐ-CP (Chính phủ) as its implementing decree. If it mentions Nghị định 13/2023/NĐ-CP, it says that decree no longer applies from 01/01/2026. Each document appears once with its number and issuer. The assistant may open documents with get_document to confirm them, and may list related laws as related rather than governing.

positive.description: Show a law's table of contents (get_summary).
positive.prompt: Use Lawgical to show me the table of contents of Luật 91/2025/QH15, Vietnam's Personal Data Protection Law.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the outline of Luật 91/2025/QH15: 5 Chương and 39 Điều — Chương I (Điều 1–8), Chương II with Mục 1 (Điều 9–23) and Mục 2 (Điều 24–32), Chương III (Điều 33–35), Chương IV (Điều 36–37), Chương V (Điều 38–39). Headings may be translated.

positive.description: List the Luật in force on a topic (get_laws).
positive.prompt: Use Lawgical to list the Vietnamese laws (Luật) about đất đai that are currently in force.
positive.expected_behavior: Names Luật Đất đai 31/2024/QH15 as the land law in force (Lawgical labels it "Hết hiệu lực một phần": amended in part, still in force). It may also list the amending law 43/2024/QH15. It does not present repealed land laws (45/2013/QH13, 13/2003/QH11) as in force, and does not show the same law twice.

positive.description: Check the account's plan and remaining lookups (get_account_status).
positive.prompt: How many Lawgical lookups do I have left today?
positive.expected_behavior: Says the signed-in account is on the paid plan with unlimited lookups, so there is no daily limit (tool text: "Gói: Trả phí — không giới hạn lượt tra cứu."), and gives the renewal date the tool returns (for the review account: 06/10/2027). No payment or upgrade link is shown.

negative.description: General knowledge with no link to law: Lawgical should not be called.
negative.expected_behavior: Lawgical should not be used: this is general knowledge, not Vietnamese law. ChatGPT answers directly and cites no Lawgical or Vietnamese legal documents.

negative.description: Another country's law: Lawgical covers Vietnamese law only, so it should not be called.
negative.prompt: What does California's CCPA say about data breach notification?
negative.expected_behavior: Lawgical should not be used: it holds only Vietnamese law. ChatGPT answers without it and cites no Lawgical or Vietnamese legal documents.

negative.description: Coding task that mentions formatting rules, not a legal lookup: Lawgical should not be called.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that validates a Vietnamese phone number according to the usual formatting rules.
negative.expected_behavior: Lawgical should not be used: this is a coding task, not a legal lookup. ChatGPT writes the function itself and cites no Vietnamese legal documents.

review.commerce_description: Lawgical does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: every tool now declares its read-only, destructive, idempotent and open-world labels explicitly, and lookups read only Lawgical's own catalog of Vietnamese legal documents. The bundled skill and the review test cases match that.
